cases.expects: A Markdown summary with a one-sentence summary, the ten most critical changes or concerns (fewer if the plan truly has fewer, never padded), and five takeaways, in numbered lists with no repeated items. It must catch the real risks in the plan itself: ingress opened to 0.0.0.0/0, the public-read bucket, the forced database replacement with no final snapshot, and the deleted log group with a year of retention, stated plainly and accurately.

A Markdown summary in the upstream three-section shape (one sentence, up to ten main points of at most sixteen words each, five takeaways) as numbered lists. It should lead with the serious items: WAF association removed, deletion protection off, database encryption turned off in a way that forces replacement, and the deploy role widened to Action "*" on all resources, and note the two added NAT gateways as a cost item, without inventing figures the plan does not contain.

An accurate summary limited to what is visible: the public access block on the logs bucket being removed, Lambda memory doubled with debug logging on, the example.com record repointed to a new IP, and an incomplete IAM user creation that cannot be assessed. It must say plainly that the plan is truncated and the totals are unknown instead of inventing the missing changes or counts, and may use fewer than ten main points rather than padding.
